newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Shell reopens oil flow stations after Nigeria fire.
newsitem.headline: Shell reopens oil flow stations after Nigeria fire.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell's Nigerian producing unit has repoened 12 flow stations which were shut after a fire last week when a pipeline was being repaired, a local newspaper said on Thursday.
The majority state-owned Daily Times said a total of 135,000 barrels of crude oil was lost in production, which was shut in during the time it took to complete repairs.

Shell on Friday said two people were killed in an explosion during repair work to contain an oil spillage on the pipeline to Rumuekpe oil field northwest of Port Harcourt in the southeastern oil-producing region of Nigeria.
Shell is frequently the target of sabotage by impoverished oil-producing communites which feel cheated that Nigerian governments have not used oil wealth to develop their areas.
